This concept has various cultural implications, such as being a reminder to start fresh and make the most of each day. It can also be a time for communal gatherings, such as the pre-dawn meal or Taraweeh prayers during Ramadan.
data.spiritual_significance: Saal holds deep spiritual significance, representing the transition from the darkness of ignorance to the light of knowledge and guidance. In the Quran, Allah (swt) describes Himself as the "Lord of the two easts and the two wests". Saal is a reminder of the continuous cycles of day and night, and the cyclical nature of life. It serves as a reminder of the transient nature of this world and the need to strive for eternal salvation. It also represents hope and anticipation, as each new day brings new opportunities and blessings from Allah (swt).
